subject.title: [Feature]: Track data provenance across session boundaries for persistent state

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Plugin SDK provenance chain for durable state writes and reads, and what session/tool/origin metadata may be persisted and exposed to plugins?
rationale: The remaining work defines a public security-policy API, persisted metadata shape, plugin visibility boundary, migration behavior, and future read-time trust semantics; automation cannot choose those boundaries safely.

options.title: Design Minimal Durable Provenance API
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer/security design that specifies metadata, redaction, migration or unknown-state handling, and read-time policy before implementation.

options.title: Land Hook Prerequisites First
options.body: Use the open before_tool_call and before_persistence_write threads as prerequisites, then return to durable provenance once those contracts settle.

options.title: Externalize Until API Gap Is Proven
options.body: Defer native provenance until a plugin or MCP implementation proves which core API or storage extension is missing.

recommendation.title: Design Minimal Durable Provenance API
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer/security design that specifies metadata, redaction, migration or unknown-state handling, and read-time policy before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history on inter-session provenance and memory product/security routing among the likely owners.
